map.由半径求圆面积。: Get the area from the radius.
map.圆的面积 A = π × 半径 r 的二次方；圆周长 C = 2πr，也等于 π: Circle area A = pi x radius r squared; circumference C = 2·pi·r, also pi x diameter; diameter d = 2r; sphere volume V = 4/3 x pi x r cubed, sphere surface area S = 4·pi·r2.
map.r=5 时面积约 78.54。: r=5 gives an area of about 78.54.
map.平面几何：已知半径求圆面积，用于截面积、下料估算: Plane geometry: get the area from the radius, for cross-sections and material estimates
map.材料用量：圆板、圆盘、桩截面的: Material use: for circular plates, discs and pile cross-sections,
map.图纸核对：由面积反算半径或直径: Drawing checks: back-solve radius or diameter from the area
map.算法：圆面积 A = π·r²，并同时输出周长 C = 2π·r 便于交叉校核。: Algorithm: area A = pi·r2, and circumference C = 2·pi·r is also output for cross-checking. r can be any positive length unit and the area automatically uses the corresponding square unit (e.g. m to m2). Requires r>0.
map.例：r=5m → A=π×25=78.5398 m²、C=2π×5=31.415: Example: r=5m gives A=pi x 25=78.5398 m2 and C=2·pi x 5=31.4159m. If r=10m, A=314.1593 m2 (doubling r quadruples the area, per the square law).
map.面积和周长单位为何不同？: Why do area and circumference use different units?
map.面积是二维量用平方单位（m²），周长是一维量用长度单位（m）；二者量纲不同不可直: Area is two-dimensional and uses square units (m2), circumference is one-dimensional and uses length units (m); they have different dimensions and cannot be added. The tool outputs them separately to avoid confusion.
map.直径 d 已知怎么算？: How do I compute it if diameter d is known?
map.先用 r=d/2 转半径再代入；本工具也给出周长可反推直径（d=C/π）。例如: First convert to radius with r=d/2, then substitute; the tool also outputs the circumference so you can recover the diameter (d=C/pi). For example r=5m corresponds to diameter 10.0000m.
